full.event_eligibility: released actual peak>300 and actual peak minus frozen anchor q50>0; independent of learned geometry
full.event_amplitude_cap: entire pulse amplitude <= missed peak minus positive historical trend error; nonmatching atom yields zero payload, candidate retained
full.residual_definition: encoded mature trend minus smoothed historical anchor q50; missed positive atom only
full.feature_scaling: z bounded; prices/300; corrections/150; distances/4; age/365; counts/365 or4; movement/23

encoder_audit.architecture: local Fourier DC+first harmonic and adaptive zero-frequency Gabor pulses
encoder_audit.geometry: observed residual peak anchors; learned bounded center offset and width
encoder_audit.coefficients: observed-only joint ridge least squares; unpenalized intercept
encoder_audit.interpretation: learned geometry, analytic mature-price amplitudes; not future prediction
